result.instructions: Tools for Click2Mail, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is my Click2Mail credit balance?"; "Show the tracking for job 195795."; "Which of my mailing jobs from March are still in editing status?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Click2Mail data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run click2mail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run click2mail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run click2mail_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. click2mail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: click2mail_get_credit
tools.title: Get account credit
tools.description: The prepaid credit balance of the Click2Mail account (`balance`) and whether the balance may go negative (`allowNegative`). Check it before submitting a job paid with User Credit. GET /molpro/credit.

tools.name: click2mail_list_return_addresses
tools.title: List saved account addresses
tools.description: The addresses of one type saved on the account (return addresses, billing, business reply, courtesy reply, EDDM mailer addresses) with their ids; use an id as `return_address_id` when creating a job. GET /molpro/account/addresses.

address_type.description: Required by Click2Mail. The type, e.g. "Return Address", "Billing Address", "Business Reply", "Courtesy reply address", "Eddm Mailer Address".

tools.name: click2mail_get_product_options
tools.title: Get product options
tools.description: The mail products and valid option combinations (document class, layout, production time, envelope, color, paper, print option, mail class) for the account. Use the exact strings from this reply in click2mail_create_job and click2mail_estimate_cost. GET /molpro/productOptions.

document_class.description: Only this product, e.g. "Letter 8.5 x 11" or "Postcard 4.25 x 6".

tools.name: click2mail_estimate_cost
tools.title: Estimate mailing cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a mailing from its print options and quantity without creating anything (nothing is charged). Use the exact option strings from click2mail_get_product_options. GET /molpro/costEstimate.

tools.name: click2mail_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List the documents uploaded to the account (id, name, class, pages), most recent first. Use a document id when creating a job. GET /molpro/documents.

number_of_documents.description: How many documents to return, 1-100 (vendor default applies when omitted).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result list (default 0). Add the page size to page on.

tools.name: click2mail_get_address_list
tools.title: Get address list status
tools.description: Status of an uploaded address list: processing state (3 = CASS-standardized and ready for a job), name and counts. GET /molpro/addressLists/{id}.

tools.name: click2mail_get_address_list_info
tools.title: Get address list details
tools.description: Details of an address list: its addresses with the standardization result of each. Click2Mail returns 10 addresses by default: page with limit and offset. GET /molpro/addressLists/info.

limit.description: How many addresses to return (vendor default 10).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result list (default 0). Add the page size to page on.

tools.name: click2mail_check_addresses
tools.title: Check and correct addresses
tools.description: Validate and standardize up to 100 US postal addresses (USPS/CASS correction) before mailing. Read-only: nothing is saved or sent. POST /molpro/addressCorrection.

tools.name: click2mail_create_address_list
tools.title: Create address list
tools.description: WRITE: upload a recipient address list (up to 500 addresses) to the account. The list is standardized (CASS) by Click2Mail; poll click2mail_get_address_list until status 3, then use its id in click2mail_create_job. Creates data only; nothing is mailed or charged. POST /molpro/addressLists.

country.description: Leave empty for the US; otherwise the country name or code.

tools.name: click2mail_upload_document_from_url
tools.title: Upload document from URL
tools.description: WRITE: have Click2Mail fetch a PDF (or other supported file) from a public http(s) URL and store it as a document on the account. Returns the document id for click2mail_create_job. Creates data only; nothing is mailed or charged. POST /molpro/documents/url.

document_name.description: A name for the document (must be unique on the account).

document_class.description: The product the document is for, e.g. "Letter 8.5 x 11", "Postcard 4.25 x 6".

tools.name: click2mail_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the account's projects (jobs are grouped by project; jobs without one are grouped by month, e.g. "March 2022"), most recently updated first. Use a project name with click2mail_list_project_jobs. GET /molpro/projects.

number_of_projects.description: How many projects to return, 1-100 (vendor default applies when omitted).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result list (default 0). Add the page size to page on.

tools.name: click2mail_list_project_jobs
tools.title: List jobs in a project
tools.description: List the mailing jobs of one project (id, status, description). This is how to see the account's jobs: pick a project from click2mail_list_projects. GET /molpro/projects/jobs.

number_of_jobs.description: How many jobs to return, 1-100 (vendor default applies when omitted).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result list (default 0). Add the page size to page on.

tools.name: click2mail_list_jobs_by_app_signature
tools.title: List jobs by app signature
tools.description: List the jobs that were created with a given `appSignature` (the label an integration puts on its jobs; click2mail_create_job sets it). GET /molpro/jobs/appSignature.

number_of_jobs.description: How many jobs to return, 1-100 (vendor default applies when omitted).

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the result list (default 0). Add the page size to page on.

tools.name: click2mail_get_job_status
tools.title: Get job status
tools.description: Status of a job: numeric `status` and its `description` (for example 9 = Editing) plus the status URL. GET /molpro/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: click2mail_get_job_info
tools.title: Get job details
tools.description: Full details of a job: print options, document, address list, dates, cost and payment. GET /molpro/jobs/info/{id}.

tools.name: click2mail_get_job_tracking
tools.title: Get job tracking
tools.description: USPS tracking for a submitted job: per mail piece barcode, address, status, date and location. Tracking updates once a day, so one call per day is enough; nothing is tracked on staging. GET /molpro/jobs/{id}/tracking.

tracking_type.description: IMB (Intelligent Mail barcode, default) or IMPB (package).

tracking_detail.description: Include the full scan history of each piece.

tools.name: click2mail_get_job_cost
tools.title: Get job cost
tools.description: The exact cost of a created job (postage, printing, fees) for a payment type. Read it before click2mail_submit_job. GET /molpro/jobs/{id}/cost.

payment_type.description: Default "Credit Card" at the vendor; use "User Credit" for account credit.

tools.name: click2mail_create_job
tools.title: Create job (draft)
tools.description: WRITE: create a mailing job from an uploaded document and an address list. The job stays a draft (status Editing): nothing is printed, mailed or charged until click2mail_submit_job. Use the exact option strings from click2mail_get_product_options. Returns the job id. POST /molpro/jobs.

layout.description: e.g. "Address on Separate Page", "Double Sided Postcard".

envelope.description: e.g. "#10 Double Window"; empty or "NONE" for postcards.

app_signature.description: Label to find the job again with click2mail_list_jobs_by_app_signature.

project_id.description: Project id to file the job in.

tools.name: click2mail_request_job_proof
tools.title: Request job proof
tools.description: WRITE: ask Click2Mail to render a proof (preview PDF) of a draft job. Free; nothing is mailed or charged. The reply names the proof; it takes a moment to render. POST /molpro/jobs/{id}/proof.

tools.name: click2mail_submit_job
tools.title: Submit job (spends money)
tools.description: WRITE, SPENDS MONEY, NOT REVERSIBLE: submit a draft job for printing and USPS mailing. This charges postage and printing to the account (User Credit = prepaid balance, or Invoice) and the physical mail is sent to every recipient. Before calling: read click2mail_get_job_cost and click2mail_get_credit, and get the user's explicit go-ahead for this job and amount. `confirm` must be true. Cancellation is only possible for Invoice jobs, before processing starts. POST /molpro/jobs/{id}/submit.

billing_type.description: "User Credit" charges the prepaid balance; "Invoice" bills the account. Card payments are not supported here.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved submitting this job and its cost.

tools.name: click2mail_cancel_job
tools.title: Cancel submitted job
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a SUBMITTED job. The vendor documents this only for jobs paid by invoice and only before processing for mailing has started; otherwise it fails. The mailing is stopped for good, so get the user's explicit go-ahead first; `confirm` must be true. To remove a draft use click2mail_delete_job. POST /molpro/jobs/{id}/cancel.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved cancelling this submitted job.

tools.name: click2mail_delete_job
tools.title: Delete draft job
tools.description: WRITE: delete a job that has not been submitted (status Editing or PendingProofAcceptence). Submitted jobs cannot be deleted; use click2mail_cancel_job. POST /molpro/jobs/{id}/delete.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Click2Mail
prompts.description: What you can do with Click2Mail here, with example requests to try.
